title: A parity Erdős-Hajnal theorem for $t$-intersecting curves
summary: For every fixed $t\ge 1$, we prove a parity analogue of the mighty Erdős-Hajnal property for $t$-intersecting curves in the plane. Let $\mathcal B$ be a set of blue curves and $\mathcal G$ a set of green curves in the plane such that $\mathcal B\cup\mathcal G$ is a collection of $t$-intersecting curves in general position. We show that there exist subfamilies $\mathcal B'\subseteq\mathcal B$ and $\mathcal G'\subseteq\mathcal G$ such that $|\mathcal B'|\geq \varepsilon|\mathcal B|$ and $|\mathcal G'|\geq \varepsilon|\mathcal G|$, where $\varepsilon>0$ depends only on $t$, such that either…
